exact_missing_items: `Plans/Contracts_V0.md` still lacks named canonical contracts for:
`Plans/Contracts_V0.md` still preserves forbidden `detached_window` in the closed `target_kind` enum.
`Plans/orchestrator-subagent-integration.md` still actively carries `TierContext` / `tier_id` residue, and `Plans/Contracts_V0.md` still preserves `detached_window`.
`inspector_target` is still useful, but it should stay for reusable detail-pane or subsection focus, not as a universal dumping ground for all feature-local anchors.

Sub-selection is handled by one of three mechanisms: `OpenFile` specialization for `line`/`range`; `inspector_target` for reusable detail-surface focus; object-family-specific anchor fields only when the anchor is truly domain-local and not reusable
Define `inspector_target` narrowly in the contract layer as reusable detail/subsection focus.
acknowledge is closest to noise-control / ownership-signaling
dismiss is a durable semantic judgment and must not look like closing a toast
resolve is not one generic operation; it needs resolution_kind
merge / split / supersede are structural lineage edits, not ordinary state toggles
concern actions never hard-delete canonical concern history in normal operation
concern undo should generally be implemented as compensating follow-up records (reopened, reverse-merge lineage, successor concern, etc.), not history erasure
